name: CrossTex LIG Extension
researcher_notes: EIA August 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 442: CrossTex LIG Extension, Crosstex Energy Services, expansion, completed April 2007, Louisiana intrastate, 74 miles, 16 and 24 inch, 200 MMcf/d additional capacity, cost 90 million USD. A Crosstex Energy 10-K filed with the SEC in 2012 describes the north Louisiana LIG system as 63 miles of 24 inch mainline plus 9 miles of gathering lateral (72 miles in total), which agrees with the EIA length and confirms the 2007 northward extension south of Shreveport; it does not give the 74 mile, 16 inch or 90 million figures, so those rest on EIA alone. The 10-K was not added as a ref because it states no staged value exactly. This is a separate segment from the existing LIG row P0210 (2000 miles, Cotton Valley to New Orleans); GEM tracks expansions as their own rows, so this is staged as one, not a match. It adds more than 25 km of sourced new pipe. The line is intrastate, so no FERC filing is expected. Not found: a Texas or Louisiana state regulator document and any GIS route. Capacity 200 MMcf/d is the incremental figure from EIA. Owner shown as the operator named by EIA; the owner is no exact match in the gazetteer and a person should confirm (EnLink Midstream LLC is the later parent). Route not found, so no route.
